biography.plain_text: Don Robert Hankey is an American billionaire financier and founder of Hankey Group. Building on his family’s Los Angeles motor-dealership platform, he acquired Midway Ford and developed in-house loans for buyers excluded by mainstream lenders. That operation became Westlake Financial, the finance-led core of a wider private group spanning insurance, software, property and automotive services.

long_biography.plain_text:
Westlake Financial grew from a lending desk inside Midway Ford. Don Hankey saw that customers with limited credit were being turned away, began financing purchases himself and later separated the loan operation from the dealership. Extending the model to outside dealers, supported by technology-driven underwriting and dealer software, turned a local retail solution into the central asset of his business.

Hankey organised the resulting companies under Hankey Group, where lending, insurance, dealer technology, vehicle services and property are designed to reinforce one another. His role consequently widened from dealership operator to capital allocator across a private holding company. Current company materials identify him as founder and principal, while dedicated executives run the major operating businesses.
